text:
maria: Quick a11y ping — found inconsistent focus outlines in the new Model Insights table. On mac + Chrome the row focus disappears when tabbing. Anyone else seeing this?

jon: Yep, I saw that. It seems to happen after we apply transform/stacking-context optimizations (we add `transform: translateZ(0)` on rows). The outline gets clipped.

tess: Could also be outline-offset getting lost because of overflow:hidden on the container. Also the selected-row bg (#f2f7ff) vs text color has low contrast when the row label is blue. Need to ensure at least 3:1 for large text / 4.5:1 for normal.

samir: There's also a keyboard-trap on the inline action menu in the row. Tab goes into the menu but sometimes can't tab back out to the next row — I think it's due to a focusable invisible anchor we added.

maria: Steps to repro: open /insights -> Tab to table -> use arrow keys to move -> Enter on a row to open inline menu -> press Tab -> focus lands in overlay, Shift+Tab doesn't always return to table row. Happened on Chrome + FF.

a11y-bot: Automated note: Lighthouse keyboard-navigation audit failed on /insights/table (run 2026-11-03).

jon: Quick local experiment: removing `transform` from `.row` while focused fixes the outline. Another approach: use `box-shadow` for the focus indicator instead of `outline`, since box-shadow isn't clipped by stacking contexts.

kate: Box-shadow sounds better. Also saw chart legend issues — VoiceOver reads legend items out of order and doesn't announce which series each color corresponds to. We should add `role="img"` + an `aria-label` that summarizes the chart, and ensure each legend item has an accessible name.

tess: Example CSS I tried locally:
```css
.row:focus-visible {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(10,132,255,0.9);
  outline: none;
}
```
This keeps the ring even when the row is in a stacking context. Need to test in dark theme as well.

samir: Which blue token should we use so contrast is good across light/dark? Using `blue-500` (#0A84FF) on white hits ~3.9:1, so for 4.5:1 we should use `blue-600` (#0066D6) or bump the background. I'll pick `blue-600` for normal text.

maria: Action items: samir -> create a Jira ticket with repro steps + screenshots and tag @eng-platform and @devex. tess -> update component styles and include dark-mode checks. kate -> run VoiceOver + Narrator on mac/win and report exact phrasing. I'll pair with jon on the overlay focus trap.

jon: I'll open a small PR: remove `transform` on focus, switch to box-shadow for focus-visible, add `aria-labelledby` to charts, and add a simple e2e keyboard test that tabs through table rows and menu.

kate: Small accessibility nit: toasts currently use `aria-live="assertive"` which interrupts screen readers. For non-critical toasts use `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-atomic="true"` so users don't lose context.

maria: Thanks all :heart: Please add screenshots, browser versions, and the short repro steps to the ticket.

samir: Filed ticket INF-4128 and linked this thread. Added a screenshot and minimal repro steps.

jon: Thanks — I'll reference INF-4128 in the PR.
